title: [SEC0] Race condition: state events before chat selection lose messages
description:
Location: web/app.js lines 519-587, specifically the check at line 532

The renderApp() function calls startEventSource() immediately after fetchChats(), but fetchMessages() (which sets messageState) is not called until the user selects a chat via selectChat().

If a state event arrives before messageState is set:
- Line 532 checks `messageState !== null` and skips the Message/changes call
- The event is silently ignored
- New messages arriving before the user selects a chat are never fetched

Correct behavior: Either (1) fetch initial messages for the most recent chat during bootstrap, setting messageState early, or (2) when a state event arrives with messages for a chat that hasn't been loaded yet, fetch those messages anyway.

Current behavior: Messages arriving during startup (before user clicks a chat) are dropped. This is a data loss bug.

Affected code:
- line 532: `if (changed.Message && messageState !== null)` skips Message/changes if messageState is null
- The Message/changes call on line 533 is the only way to learn about new messages
- If currentChatId is null (no chat selected), the messages are still fetched on line 555-567 but only if the call succeeded; however if messageState was null the call wasn't made at all.
